Paighambar! Yeh log aap se anfaal ke baare mein sawaal karte hain, to aap keh dijiye ke anfaal sab Allah aur Rasool ke liye hain. Lihaaza tum log Allah se daro aur aapas mein islaah karo aur Allah o Rasool ki itaa'at karo agar tum us par imaan rakhne waale ho

Saahibaan-e-imaan dar-haqeeqat woh log hain jin ke saamne zikr-e-Khuda kiya jaaye to un ke dilon mein khauf-e-Khuda paida ho, aur us ki aayaton ki tilaawat ki jaaye to un ke imaan mein izaafa ho jaaye, aur woh log Allah hi par tawakkul karte hain
Woh log namaaz qaaim karte hain aur hamaare diye hue rizq mein se infaaq bhi karte hain
Yahi log haqeeqatan saahib-e-imaan hain aur unhi ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan darajaat aur maghfirat aur ba-izzat rozi hai
Jis tarah tumhaare Rab ne tumhein tumhaare ghar se haq ke saath baraamad kiya, agarche momineen ki ek jamaa'at use naapasand kar rahi thi
Yeh log aap se haq ke waazeh ho jaane ke baad bhi us ke baare mein behs karte hain, jaise ke maut ki taraf hankaaye ja rahe hon aur hasrat se dekh rahe hon

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab ke Khuda tum se wa'da kar raha tha ke do girohon mein se ek tumhaare liye bahar-haal hai, aur tum chaahte the ke woh taaqat waala giroh na ho, aur Allah apne kalimaat ke zariye haq ko saabit karna chaahta hai aur kuffaar ke silsile ko qat'a kar dena chaahta hai
Taake haq saabit ho jaaye aur baatil fana ho jaaye, chaahe mujrimeen use kis qadr bura kyon na samjhein
Jab tum Parwardigar se faryaad kar rahe the to us ne tumhaari faryaad sun li ke main ek hazaar malaaika se tumhaari madad kar raha hoon jo baraabar ek ke peechhe ek aa rahe hain
Aur ise hum ne sirf ek bashaarat qaraar diya taake tumhaare dil mutma'in ho jaayein, aur madad to sirf Allah hi ki taraf se hai. Allah hi saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Jis waqt Khuda tum par neend ghaalib kar raha tha jo tumhaare liye baa'is-e-sukoon thi, aur aasmaan se paani naazil kar raha tha taake tumhein paakeeza bana de aur tum se Shaitaan ki kasaafat ko door kar de, aur tumhaare dilon ko mutma'in bana de aur tumhaare qadmon ko sabaat ata kar de

Jab tumhaara Parwardigar malaaika ko wahi kar raha tha ke main tumhaare saath hoon, lihaaza tum saahibaan-e-imaan ko sabaat-e-qadam ata karo. Main anqareeb kuffaar ke dilon mein ro'b paida kar doonga, lihaaza tum kuffaar ki gardan ko maar do aur un ki tamaam ungliyon ke por por kaat do
Yeh is liye hai ke un logon ne Khuda o Rasool ki mukhaalifat ki hai, aur jo Khuda o Rasool ki mukhaalifat karega to Khuda us ke liye sakht azaab karne waala hai
Yeh to duniya ki saza hai jise yahaan chakho, aur us ke baad kaafiron ke liye Jahannam ka azaab bhi hai
Ae imaan waalo! Jab kuffaar se maidaan-e-jang mein mulaaqaat karo to khabardaar inhein peeth na dikhaana

Aur jo aaj ke din peeth dikhaaega woh ghazab-e-Ilaahi ka haqdaar hoga aur us ka thikaana Jahannam hoga jo badtareen anjaam hai, ilaawa un logon ke jo jangi hikmat-e-amali ki bina par peechhe hat jaayein ya kisi doosre giroh ki panaah lene ke liye apni jagah chhod dein

Pas tum logon ne un kuffaar ko qatl nahin kiya balke Khuda ne qatl kiya hai, aur Paighambar! Aap ne sangreze nahin phenke hain balke Khuda ne phenke hain, taake saahibaan-e-imaan par khoob achchhi tarah ehsaan kar de, ke woh sab ki sunne waala aur sab ka haal jaanne waala hai
Yeh to yeh ehsaan hai, aur Khuda kuffaar ke makr ko kamzor banaane waala hai

Agar tum log fatah chaahte ho to yeh fatah aa gayi, aur agar tum jang se baaz aa jaao to is mein tumhaare liye bhalaai hai, aur agar dobaara aisa karoge to hum bhi palat kar aa rahe hain, aur tumhaara giroh kitna hi bada kyon na ho kaam aane waala nahin hai, aur Allah hamesha saahibaan-e-imaan ke saath hai
Imaan waalo! Allah o Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur us se roo-gardaani na karo jab ke tum sun bhi rahe ho
Aur un logon jaise na ho jaao jo yeh kehte hain ke hum ne suna, haalaanke woh kuch nahin sun rahe hain
Allah ke nazdeek badtareen zameen par chalne waale woh behre aur goonge hain jo aql se kaam nahin lete hain
Aur agar Khuda un mein kisi khair ko dekhta to inhein zaroor sunaata, aur agar suna bhi deta to yeh munh phira lete aur e'raaz se kaam lete

Ae imaan waalo! Allah o Rasool ki aawaaz par labbaik kaho jab woh tumhein us amr ki taraf daawat dein jis mein tumhaari zindagi hai, aur yaad rakho ke Khuda insaan aur us ke dil ke darmiyaan haail ho jaata hai, aur tum sab usi ki taraf haazir kiye jaaoge
Aur us fitne se bacho jo sirf zaalimeen ko pahunchne waala nahin hai, aur yaad rakho ke Allah sakht-tareen azaab ka maalik hai

Musalmaano! Us waqt ko yaad karo jab tum Makka mein qaleel ta'daad mein aur kamzor the, tum har aan darte the ke log tumhein uchak le jaayenge, ke Khuda ne tumhein panaah di aur apni madad se tumhaari taaeed ki, tumhein paakeeza rozi ata ki taake tum us ka shukriya ada karo
Imaan waalo! Khuda o Rasool aur apni amaanaton ke baare mein khiyaanat na karo jab ke tum jaante bhi ho
Aur jaan lo ke yeh tumhaari aulaad aur tumhaare amwaal ek aazmaaish hain, aur Khuda ke paas ajr-e-azeem hai

Imaan waalo! Agar tum taqwa-e-Ilaahi ikhtiyaar karoge to woh tumhein haq o baatil mein tafriqe ki salaahiyat ata kar dega, tumhaari buraaiyon ki parda-poshi karega, tumhaare gunaahon ko maaf kar dega, ke woh bada fazl karne waala hai

Aur Paighambar! Aap us waqt ko yaad karein jab kuffaar tadbeerein karte the ke aap ko qaid kar lein ya shehar-badar kar dein ya qatl kar dein, aur un ki tadbeeron ke saath Khuda bhi us ke khilaaf intizaam kar raha tha, aur woh behtareen intizaam karne waala hai
Aur un ka yeh haal hai ke jab hamaari aayaton ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to kehte hain ke sun liya, hum khud bhi chaahein to aisa hi keh sakte hain, yeh to sirf pichhle logon ki daastaanein hain
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab unhon ne kaha ke Khudaya! Agar yeh teri taraf se haq hai to hum par aasmaan se patthar barsa de ya azaab-e-aleem naazil kar de
Haalaanke Allah un par us waqt tak azaab na karega jab tak, Paighambar, aap un ke darmiyaan hain, aur Khuda un par azaab karne waala nahin hai agar yeh tauba aur istighfaar karne waale ho jaayein

Aur un ke liye kaun si baat hai ke Khuda un par azaab na kare jab ke yeh logon ko Masjid-ul-Haraam se rokte hain aur us ke mutawalli bhi nahin hain? Us ke waali sirf muttaqi aur parhezgaar afraad hain, lekin un ki aksariyat is se bhi bekhabar hai
Un ki to namaaz bhi Masjid-ul-Haraam ke paas sirf taali aur seeti hai, lihaaza ab tum log apne kufr ki bina par azaab ka maza chakho

Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya yeh apne amwaal ko sirf is liye kharch karte hain ke logon ko raah-e-Khuda se rokein. To yeh kharch bhi karenge aur us ke baad yeh baat un ke liye hasrat bhi banegi aur aakhir mein maghloob bhi ho jaayenge, aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya yeh sab Jahannam ki taraf le jaaye jaayenge
Taake Khuda khabees ko paakeeza se alag kar de, aur phir khabees ko ek par ek rakh kar dher bana de aur sab ko ikattha Jahannam mein jhonk de, ke yahi log khasaare aur ghaate waale hain

Paighambar! Aap kaafiron se keh dijiye ke agar yeh log apne kufr se baaz aa jaayein to un ke guzishta gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge, lekin agar phir palat gaye to guzishta logon ka tareeqa bhi guzar chuka hai

Aur tum log un kuffaar se jihaad karo yahaan tak ke fitne ka wujood na reh jaaye aur saara deen sirf Allah ke liye reh jaaye. Phir agar yeh log baaz aa jaayein to Allah un ke aamaal ka khoob dekhne waala hai
Aur agar dobaara palat jaayein to yaad rakho ke Khuda tumhaara Maula aur sarparast hai, aur woh behtareen Maula o Maalik aur behtareen madadgaar hai

Aur yeh jaan lo ke tumhein jis cheez se bhi faaida haasil ho us ka paanchwaan hissa Allah, Rasool, Rasool ke qaraabatdaar, aitaam, masaakeen aur musaafiraan-e-ghurbat-zada ke liye hai, agar tumhaara imaan Allah par hai aur us nusrat par hai jo hum ne apne bande par haq o baatil ke faisle ke din, jab do jamaa'atein aapas mein takra rahi thin, naazil ki thi, aur Allah har shai par qaadir hai

Jab ke tum waadi ke qareebi mahaaz par the aur woh log door waale mahaaz par the, aur qaafila tum se nasheeb mein tha, aur agar tum pehle se jihaad ke wa'de par nikalte to yaqeenan us ke khilaaf karte, lekin Khuda hone waale amr ka faisla karna chaahta tha taake jo halaak ho woh daleel ke saath aur jo zinda rahe woh bhi daleel ke saath, aur Allah sab ki sunne waala aur sab ke haal-e-dil ka jaanne waala hai

Jab Khuda un ko tumhaari nazron mein kam kar ke dikhla raha tha, ke agar ziyaada dikhla deta to tum sust pad jaate aur aapas hi mein jhagda karne lagte, lekin Khuda ne tumhein us jhagde se bacha liya, ke woh dil ke raazon se bhi baakhabar hai

Aur jab Khuda muqaable ke waqt tumhaari nazron mein dushmanon ko kam dikhla raha tha aur un ki nazron mein tumhein kam kar ke dikhla raha tha, taake us amr ka faisla kar de jo hone waala tha, aur saare umoor ki baazgasht Allah hi ki taraf hai
Imaan waalo! Jab kisi giroh se muqaabla karo to sabaat-e-qadam se kaam lo aur Allah ko bahut yaad karo ke shaayad isi tarah kaamyaabi haasil kar lo
Aur Allah aur us ke Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur aapas mein ikhtilaaf na karo ke kamzor pad jaao aur tumhaari hawa bigad jaaye, aur sabr karo ke Allah sabr karne waalon ke saath hai
Aur un logon jaise na ho jaao jo apne gharon se itraate hue aur logon ko dikhaane ke liye nikle aur raah-e-Khuda se rokte rahe, ke Allah un ke aamaal ka ihaata kiye hue hai

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Shaitaan ne un ke liye un ke aamaal ko aaraasta kar diya aur kaha ke aaj koi tum par ghaalib aane waala nahin hai aur main tumhaara madadgaar hoon. Us ke baad jab donon giroh aamne saamne aaye to ulte paaon bhaag nikla aur kaha ke main tum logon se bari hoon, main woh dekh raha hoon jo tum nahin dekh rahe ho, aur main Allah se darta hoon ke woh sakht azaab karne waala hai

Jab munaafiqeen aur jin ke dilon mein khot tha keh rahe the ke un logon ko un ke deen ne dhoka diya hai, haalaanke jo shakhs Allah par e'temaad karta hai to Khuda har shai par ghaalib aane waala aur badi hikmat waala hai
Kaash tum dekhte ke jab farishte un ki jaan nikaal rahe the aur un ke munh aur peeth par maarte jaate the ke ab Jahannam ka maza chakho
Yeh is liye ke tumhaare pichhle aamaal ka nateeja yahi hai, aur Khuda apne bandon par zulm karne waala nahin hai

Jo haal Aal-e-Fir'aun aur un se pehle waalon ka tha, ke unhon ne aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ka inkaar kiya to Khuda ne inhein un ke gunaahon ki giraft mein le liya, ke Allah qawi bhi hai aur shadeed azaab karne waala bhi hai
Yeh is liye ke Khuda kisi qaum ko di hui ne'mat ko us waqt tak nahin badalta jab tak woh khud apne taeen taghayyur na paida kar dein, ke Khuda sunne waala bhi hai aur jaanne waala bhi hai

Jis tarah Aal-e-Fir'aun aur un se pehle waalon ka anjaam hua ke unhon ne Parwardigar ki aayaat ka inkaar kiya to hum ne un ke gunaahon ki bina par inhein halaak kar diya aur Aal-e-Fir'aun ko gharq kar diya, ke yeh sab ke sab zaalim the
Zameen par chalne waalon mein badtareen afraad woh hain jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya aur ab woh imaan laane waale nahin hain
Jin se aap ne ahd liya aur us ke baad woh har martaba apne ahd ko tod dete hain aur Khuda ka khauf nahin karte
Agar woh jang mein tumhaare qabze mein aa jaayein to inhein aur un ke pushtibaan sab ko nikaal baahar karo taake ibrat haasil karein
Aur agar kisi qaum se kisi khiyaanat ya bad-ahdi ka khatra hai to aap bhi un ke ahd ko un ki taraf phenk dein, ke Allah khiyaanat-kaaron ko dost nahin rakhta hai
Aur khabardaar kaafiron ko yeh khayaal na ho ke woh aage badh gaye, woh kabhi Musalmaanon ko aajiz nahin kar sakte

Aur tum sab un ke muqaable ke liye imkaani quwwat aur ghodon ki saf-bandi ka intizaam karo jis se Allah ke dushman, apne dushman aur un ke ilaawa jin ko tum nahin jaante ho aur Allah jaanta hai, sab ko khaufzada kar do, aur jo kuch bhi raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karoge sab poora poora milega aur tum par kisi tarah ka zulm nahin kiya jaaega
Aur agar woh sulh ki taraf maail hon to tum bhi jhuk jaao aur Allah par bharosa karo, ke woh sab kuch sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai
Aur agar yeh aap ko dhoka dena chaahenge to Khuda aap ke liye kaafi hai. Us ne aap ki taaeed apni nusrat aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke zariye ki hai

Aur un ke dilon mein mohabbat paida kar di hai, ke agar aap saari duniya kharch kar dete to bhi un ke dilon mein baahami ulfat nahin paida kar sakte the, lekin Khuda ne yeh ulfat o mohabbat paida kar di hai, ke woh har shai par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Ae Paighambar! Aap ke liye Khuda aur woh momineen kaafi hain jo aap ka ittibaa' karne waale hain

Ae Paighambar! Aap logon ko jihaad par aamaada karein. Agar un mein bees bhi sabr karne waale honge to do sau par ghaalib aa jaayenge, aur agar sau honge to hazaaron kaafiron par ghaalib aa jaayenge, is liye ke kuffaar samajhdaar qaum nahin hain

Ab Allah ne tumhaara baar halka kar diya hai aur us ne dekh liya hai ke tum mein kamzori paayi jaati hai. To agar tum mein sau bhi sabr karne waale honge to do sau par ghaalib aa jaayenge, aur agar hazaar honge to ba-hukm-e-Khuda do hazaar par ghaalib aa jaayenge, aur Allah sabr karne waalon ke saath hai

Kisi nabi ko yeh haq nahin hai ke woh qaidi bana kar rakhe jab tak zameen mein jihaad ki sakhtiyon ka saamna na kare. Tum log to sirf maal-e-duniya chaahte ho jab ke Allah aakhirat chaahta hai, aur wahi saahib-e-izzat o hikmat hai
Agar Khuda ki taraf se pehle faisla na ho chuka hota to tum logon ne jo fidya le liya tha us par azaab-e-azeem naazil ho jaata
Pas ab jo maal-e-ghaneemat haasil kar liya hai use khaao ke woh halaal aur paakeeza hai, aur taqwa-e-Ilaahi ikhtiyaar karo ke Allah bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Ae Paighambar! Apne haath ke qaidiyon se keh dijiye ke agar Khuda tumhaare dilon mein neki dekhega to jo maal tum se le liya gaya hai us se behtar neki tumhein ata kar dega aur tumhein maaf kar dega, ke woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur agar yeh aap se khiyaanat karna chaahte hain to is se pehle Khuda se khiyaanat kar chuke hain, jis ke baad Khuda ne un par qaaboo ata kar diya, ke woh sab kuch jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne hijrat ki aur raah-e-Khuda mein apne jaan o maal se jihaad kiya, aur jinhon ne panaah di aur madad ki, yeh sab aapas mein ek doosre ke waali hain. Aur jin logon ne imaan ikhtiyaar kar ke hijrat nahin ki un ki wilaayat se aap ka koi ta'alluq nahin hai jab tak hijrat na karein, aur agar deen ke mu'aamale mein tum se madad maangein to tumhaara farz hai ke madad kar do, ilaawa us qaum ke muqaable ke jis se tumhaara mu'aahida ho chuka hai, ke Allah tumhaare aamaal ko khoob dekhne waala hai
Jo log kufr waale hain woh aapas mein ek doosre ke madadgaar hain, aur agar tum imaan waalon ki madad na karoge to zameen mein fitna aur azeem fasaad barpa ho jaaega

Aur jin logon ne imaan ikhtiyaar kiya aur hijrat ki aur raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad kiya, aur panaah di aur nusrat ki, wahi dar-haqeeqat waaqe'i momin hain, aur unhi ke liye maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq hai

Aur jo log baad mein imaan le aaye aur hijrat ki aur aap ke saath jihaad kiya woh bhi tum hi mein se hain, aur qaraabatdaar kitaab-e-Khuda mein sab aapas mein ek doosre se ziyaada awwaliyat aur qurbat rakhte hain. Beshak Allah har shai ka behtareen jaanne waala hai
